classifier.question: What is the minimum model capability needed to answer this request correctly and follow its instructions?

tiers.name: tier_1
tiers.description: Basic: straightforward questions, simple rewriting or extraction, and routine tasks with few constraints.

tiers.name: tier_2
tiers.description: Standard: normal drafting, coding, explanation, or analysis with moderate reasoning and several constraints.

tiers.name: tier_3
tiers.description: Advanced: difficult reasoning, complex debugging or algorithms, demanding research or synthesis, or interacting constraints that require careful reasoning.
